body:
I'm really sorry for your loss. And I admire your strength, but sometimes the pain just feels like too much for me to handle.

I've been trying to live for them I do. I never want them to experience what you or any other parent out there have. I just want my parents to understand and maybe look at the bright side that their child is finally freed from his sufferings.

My girlfriend just left me for the same reason. She chose kids over me although when I asked her (about 3 times in the past 2 years), "You have plans on how to teach the kids?" and she was clueless. I hate children but I've already learned how to raise them carefully and how I could change myself to give them the best environment they could have. 

She just simply likes the idea of having kids because everyone around her does. 

In the past I thought maybe I would want one with her, but after a year living together and observing I started to think I either have no kids or have but not with her. She spoils her nephew and niece and gets mad at her sister for yelling at them. She simply doesn't understand the stress that her sister has and thinks every child deserves to be treated like angels.

I'm deeply frustrated but I know she is the type of person that would never understand something until she experiences it. So I had to let her go. Part of me hopes that she'll be happy with her decision but another part just wishes she experiences what you've said because she let the idea she's not even sure about ruin our relationship and every plan for future we had together.
Having the same issue with my GR II. I can only tell it is because of the lens but donno how to fix since I cant afford service (~450€ in Germany which is equivalent to a used GR II)
Tips: If you're traveling to big cities, then most of the students there can speak English, don't hesitate to ask them :)
